title: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane reportedly at the team's training facility after missing voluntary workouts

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane reportedly at the team's training facility after missing voluntary workouts
sources.description: Dolphins general manager Jon-Eric Sullivan shared on Wednesday that Achane is not available for trade and that the Dolphins are heading in the right direction on a contract extension.
